headline: Bond votes on wastewater upgrades, DPW garage, pool repairs, and landfill improvements worth tens of millions of dollars.
summary: The meeting covers multiple bond authorizations for wastewater treatment, sewer infrastructure, solid waste equipment, swimming pool renovation, and a new Public Works garage and fleet maintenance facility, along with several contract awards, mayoral appointments, and new ordinances on tax exemptions and utility contracts.
